markers.note: JSP place page says Joseph worked for Knight 'likely near Nineveh'; no farm or building identified, so the hamlet center is used.

markers.note: The June 1830 baptism stream is not marked: Church sources say only 'through or close to' the Knight farm and name no stream.

markers.name: Nathaniel Cole Tavern site
markers.coord_source: OSM: shared node of Watrous Road (way 12770716) and Colesville Road (way 139601917)
markers.note: BYU Religious Education Journeys calls it the 'probable location' of the June 30, 1830 Broome County trial, near the corner of Colesville Road and Watrous Road; Church sources say only 'a Colesville tavern'. Intersection is about 5 km SW of Harpursville village though the source says 'in Harpursville'.
